entries.title: Task keys in a card's choices are links
entries.body: A task key written in a checkbox or radio choice on a card now opens that task, as keys in the card's other words do. Clicking the key leaves the choice as it was; clicking the choice's other words still picks it.

picture.alt: A decision card with a checkbox reading Start SCR-1 now and a radio reading Let SCR-2 choose the format, each task key underlined as a link
